n7d440b2dacb.s: The North Eastern Space Applications Centre (NESAC) is located at:
n7d440b2dacb.x: NESAC is at Umiam (Shillong), Meghalaya, a joint body of the Department of Space and the North Eastern Council.

nf4d4ccf6e56.s: Training and education in remote sensing and GIS is the role of:
nf4d4ccf6e56.x: IIRS, Dehradun handles training and education in remote sensing and GIS; NESAC serves the North-East and SAC builds sensors.

n75ffa49dd3c.s: The Nabhmitra safety service for fishermen was developed by:
n75ffa49dd3c.x: Nabhmitra comes from ISRO's SAC, Ahmedabad and gives two-way messaging via GSAT; INCOIS with AAI developed GEMINI.

n59620ada674.s: In the INSAT Disaster Warning System, warnings from the Cyclone Warning Centre, Chennai travel by:
n59620ada674.x: The chain is Cyclone Warning Centre, Chennai, then C-band uplink, then S-band downlink to coastal disaster-warning receivers.

n3b1e2b79e40.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about ISRO's Disaster Management Support Programme?
o: It uses INSAT and IRS satellite systems
It is limited to cyclone warnings alone
It provides communication support during disasters
n3b1e2b79e40.x: The programme gives imaging and communication support for floods, cyclones, droughts and other disasters, so it is not limited to cyclones.

n81a47540108.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about satellite-based timing in India?
o: Banks use it to time-stamp transactions
Power grids use it to synchronise their phase
NavIC is now India's reference for Indian Standard Time
The government wants NavIC to serve Indian Standard Time
n81a47540108.x: GPS is the current reference; the government only wants NavIC to serve Indian Standard Time.

n7735548f86f.s: The Andhra Pradesh State Spatial Data Infrastructure (APSSDI) has standardised how many GIS layers to ISO standards?
n7735548f86f.x: APSSDI has standardised 74 GIS layers to ISO standards and is registered with the National Data Registry.

n42fe66a6fe3.s: Which of the following is a proposed way forward for a safer outer space?
o: Restricting the sharing of SSA data
Ending advance notices of space activities
Wider sharing of space situational awareness data
n42fe66a6fe3.x: More SSA data-sharing, along with advance notices and hotlines, is proposed for a safer outer space.

n7eaa7e929ad.s: Under India's 2026 re-entry rules, aircraft and ships must be warned at least how many days before re-entry?
n7eaa7e929ad.x: The 2026 rules require a warning at least 45 days before re-entry, not 30.

n9bbbdd81264.s: Which Hyderabad DRDO laboratory works on electronic warfare?
n9bbbdd81264.x: DLRL is the electronic-warfare lab; DRDL develops missiles such as MPATGM, ASL handles Agni and DMRL works on metals and armour.

nfd74754191a.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about DRDO's naval laboratories?
o: NSTL works on torpedoes and mines
nfd74754191a.x: NPOL is at Kochi; the Visakhapatnam laboratory is NSTL, which works on torpedoes and mines.

n935d3fe11ee.s: The final trials of the ULPGM-V3 missile were conducted at the test range near:
n935d3fe11ee.x: The ULPGM-V3 final trials were done near Kurnool; Nagayalanka is a planned missile test range.

new.s: Oceansat and Resourcesat are examples of:
new.x: They use natural radiation (sunlight), so they are passive; RISAT radar, which sends its own signal, is active.

new.s: How many Regional Remote Sensing Centres (RRSCs) function under NRSC?
new.x: Five RRSCs, at Bengaluru, Jodhpur, Kharagpur, Nagpur and Delhi, work under NRSC on regional projects for States.

new.s: NRSC's satellite earth station, which also receives fire-hotspot data, is at:
new.x: NRSC's earth station is at Shadnagar, where MODIS and VIIRS fire-hotspot data are received.

new.s: Satellite fire-hotspot alerts received at Shadnagar feed the alert system of:
new.x: Fire-hotspot data go to the Forest Survey of India alert system, not IMD.

new.s: Which pair of thermal-infrared sensors is used to detect forest-fire hotspots?
new.x: Fire hotspots come from MODIS (NASA Terra/Aqua) and VIIRS (Suomi-NPP).

new.s: The Decision Support Centre, a single window for satellite inputs during disasters, functions at:
new.x: The Decision Support Centre is at NRSC, and States must request data from NRSC.

new.s: According to NRSC, the most flood-prone area in India is the:
new.x: NRSC identifies the Ganga-Brahmaputra basin as India's most flood-prone area.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about disaster monitoring from space:
1. Post-earthquake ground deformation can be monitored from space.
2. Earthquakes can be predicted using satellite remote sensing.
3. Tsunami inundation can be mapped from space.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Ground deformation after a quake and tsunami inundation can be monitored; earthquake prediction cannot.

new.s: ISRO's geoportal Bhuvan, developed by NRSC, Hyderabad, was launched in:
new.x: Bhuvan was launched in 2009 by NRSC; 2012 is the year MNCFC was set up.

new.s: SVAMITVA maps rural properties by drone in partnership with:
new.x: SVAMITVA uses drone mapping of rural properties with the Survey of India to issue property cards.

new.s: Which NRSC portal archives Earth-observation data since 1988 for search and download?
new.x: Bhoonidhi is NRSC's EO data archive; VEDAS and MOSDAC belong to SAC and Srishti monitors watersheds.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
new.x: Bhuvan Panchayat serves gram panchayat planning; Srishti is for watersheds, Yuktdhara for MGNREGA assets and MOSDAC for disaster alerts.

new.s: FASAL is used mainly for:
o: Pre-harvest crop acreage and production forecasts
new.x: FASAL gives pre-harvest crop acreage and production forecasts; CHAMAN is horticulture, YES-TECH yield and NADAMS drought.

new.s: The CHAMAN programme uses space technology to assess:
new.x: CHAMAN covers horticulture area and production; jute is under JCIS and drought under NADAMS.

new.s: Which programme monitors agricultural drought using satellite data?
new.x: NADAMS monitors agricultural drought; FASAL forecasts crops, CHAMAN covers horticulture and YES-TECH yield.

new.s: YES-TECH supports the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana by providing:
new.x: YES-TECH estimates crop yield (such as rice) for crop insurance under PMFBY.

new.s: NRSC's CROP framework estimated Rabi 2024-25 wheat production at:
new.x: The CROP framework, using EOS-04, EOS-06 and Resourcesat-2A, put Rabi 2024-25 wheat at 122.724 MT.

new.s: The GEMINI device, giving PFZ, ocean-state and disaster alerts at sea, was developed by:
new.x: GEMINI was developed by INCOIS with the Airports Authority of India and uses GAGAN; Nabhmitra is SAC's device.

new.s: The second-generation Distress Alert Transmitter (DAT-SG) differs by sending fishermen:
o: An acknowledgement of the distress alert
new.x: DAT-SG has a NavIC module and sends an acknowledgement back to fishermen.

new.s: APMVTS in Andhra Pradesh tracks about how many mineral vehicles with AIS-140 devices?
new.x: APMVTS fits AIS-140 devices on about 50,000 mineral vehicles.

new.s: GAGAN, the ISRO-AAI system, has payloads on:
new.x: GAGAN payloads are carried on GSAT-8, GSAT-10 and GSAT-15.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about satellite-based services in India?
o: Village Resource Centres are run by IMD
Swayam Prabha offers 40 free DTH channels
ISRO Telemedicine Network links rural clinics to specialists
new.x: Village Resource Centres are ISRO's single-window centres, not IMD's.

new.s: The National Carbon Project of the ISRO-Geosphere Biosphere Programme assesses:
o: Carbon pools, fluxes and net carbon balance of India's terrestrial biosphere
Ocean carbon uptake in the Indian Ocean
Carbon credits traded by Indian industries
new.x: Its goal is to assess the carbon pools, fluxes and net carbon balance of India's terrestrial biosphere.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the National Carbon Project:
1. It covers vegetation carbon pools.
2. It covers soil carbon pools.
3. It is limited to the marine biosphere.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Its components are vegetation carbon pools, soil carbon pools and soil-vegetation fluxes; it studies the terrestrial, not marine, biosphere.

new.s: How many drought mandals did Andhra Pradesh declare in 2024-25 using mandal-level VCI?
new.x: AP declared 103 drought mandals in 7 districts, of which 80 were severe.

new.s: The PM Gati Shakti platform in Andhra Pradesh has how many GIS layers?
new.x: Gati Shakti AP has 271 GIS layers across 27 departments; 74 is the APSSDI figure.

new.s: APSAC's shoreline mapping covers an Andhra Pradesh coastline of about:
new.x: The 1,053 km coast is 26% eroded, 54% accreting and 20% stable.

new.s: YES-TECH yield pilots in Andhra Pradesh were run in which districts?
new.x: APSAC ran YES-TECH pilots in Nandyal and Kakinada.

new.s: Which ISRO system tracks debris and compiles the annual ISSAR?
new.x: IS4OM compiles ISSAR; NETRA is the tracking network.

new.s: Which of the following is a private space situational awareness start-up based in Bengaluru?
new.x: Digantara is a private Bengaluru start-up working on space surveillance and debris tracking; IS4OM and NETRA are ISRO's.

new.s: Which Indian satellite avoided a defunct US satellite in 2019?
new.x: RISAT-2B made a manoeuvre in 2019 to avoid a defunct US satellite.

new.s: Donald Kessler of NASA described the Kessler Syndrome in:
new.x: Kessler described the syndrome in 1978: debris density leads to collisions, more fragments and unusable orbits.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Kessler Syndrome:
1. High debris density leads to collisions.
2. Collisions produce more fragments.
3. It makes orbits more usable over time.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Density leads to collisions and more fragments, which make orbits unusable, so statement 3 is wrong.

new.s: MMOD (micrometeoroids and orbital debris) is the top risk in which orbit?
new.x: MMOD is the top risk in low Earth orbit, not GEO.

new.s: According to ESA (2025), the number of space objects larger than 1 cm is over:
new.x: ESA (2025) counts over 1.2 million objects larger than 1 cm.

new.s: POEM-4, which re-entered over the Indian Ocean on 4 April 2025, flew on:
new.x: POEM-4 flew on PSLV-C60 (SpaDeX); PSLV-C62 planned a PS4 de-boost.

new.s: The PSLV-C62 mission of January 2026 planned:
new.x: PSLV-C62 planned a de-boost of its PS4 stage.

new.s: The Artemis Accords, which India signed in 2023, were launched by the US in:
new.x: The US launched the non-binding Artemis Accords in 2020; India signed in 2023.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Artemis Accords:
1. They are legally binding on signatories.
2. India signed them in 2023.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: The Accords are non-binding, so 1 is wrong; India signed them in 2023.

new.s: Which Article of the Outer Space Treaty deals with liability?
new.x: Article VII deals with liability; Article VI is national responsibility and Article IX due regard.

new.s: The Moon Agreement of 1979 is based on the principle of:
new.x: The Moon Agreement treats the Moon as common heritage; India signed but has not ratified it.

new.s: The convention requiring space objects to be registered with the UN was adopted in:
new.x: The Registration Convention is of 1975; India is a party.

new.s: DRDO was formed in 1958 by merging the TDEs, the DTDP and the:
new.x: DRDO came from merging the Army's TDEs, the DTDP and the Defence Science Organisation.

new.s: In which year was DRDO formed?
new.x: DRDO was formed in 1958.

new.s: DRDO began with 10 laboratories; it now has about:
new.x: DRDO has grown from 10 labs to about 52.

new.s: DRDO's parent department under the Ministry of Defence is the:
o: Department of Defence Research and Development
new.x: DRDO works under the Department of Defence R&D, whose Secretary is also Chairman of DRDO.

new.s: Dr Samir V. Kamat has been Chairman of DRDO since:
new.x: Dr Samir V. Kamat has been Chairman since 2022, after Dr G. Satheesh Reddy.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about DRDO's structure:
1. The Secretary, Department of Defence R&D is also Chairman of DRDO.
2. Lab directors report directly to the Defence Minister.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: The Secretary DDR&D is Chairman; lab directors report to their cluster Director General, so 2 is wrong.

new.s: DIPAS, DFRL, DEBEL and INMAS belong to which DRDO technology cluster?
new.x: These four labs form the Life Sciences cluster.

new.s: CVRDE and VRDE form which DRDO technology cluster?
new.x: CVRDE and VRDE make up the Combat Vehicles cluster; ARDE and HEMRL are Armaments.

new.s: DFRL, DRDO's laboratory for food and MREs, is located at:
new.x: DFRL is at Mysuru.

new.s: CAIR, Bengaluru works on:
new.x: CAIR works on AI and robotics; DLRL is electronic warfare, DEBEL oxygen plants and NPOL sonars.

new.s: The Agni series of missiles is handled by which Hyderabad laboratory?
new.x: ASL handles the Agni series; DRDL develops MPATGM and RCI guidance and seekers.

new.s: Research Centre Imarat (RCI), Hyderabad specialises in:
new.x: RCI works on guidance and seekers; DMRL handles metals and armour.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
new.x: CVRDE, which works on the Arjun tank, is at Chennai, not Pune.

new.s: DIAT Pune, supported by DRDO, is a:
new.x: DIAT Pune is a deemed university.

new.s: DRDO Young Scientist Labs, set up in 2020, number:
new.x: There are 5 Young Scientist Labs in 5 futuristic areas; 15 is the number of DIA-CoEs.

new.s: DRDO's medical oxygen plant technology comes from which Bengaluru laboratory?
new.x: DEBEL, Bengaluru developed the medical oxygen plant.

new.s: DRDO's bio-toilets were developed by:
new.x: Bio-toilets come from DRDE Gwalior and DRL Tezpur.

new.s: The Netra mini-UAV was developed by DRDO's Pune laboratories with:
new.x: Netra, a ~1.5 kg mini-UAV for police and disaster use, was built with IdeaForge; it is different from the Netra AEW&C.

new.s: Amtooth, a DRDO herbal product, is used for:
new.x: Amtooth treats toothache; Lukoskin is for leucoderma and Eczit for eczema.

new.s: DRDO has given Indian industry free Transfers of Technology numbering more than:
new.x: DRDO has given 2,100+ free ToTs and opened test facilities to the private sector.

new.s: Under the August 2026 decision, which missiles stay in state production?
new.x: Astra, Rudram, Nag and VSHORADS were approved for ToT; Agni and K-series stay in state production.

new.s: The ADA flight-testing complex costing ₹15,803 crore is planned in which Andhra Pradesh district?
new.x: The ADA flight-testing complex is planned in Sri Sathya Sai district.

new.s: NSTL, Visakhapatnam has developed:
new.x: NSTL develops Varunastra, mines and SMART; Pinaka is ARDE's.
